_readme: Lines she uses for check-ins (and when there is no Claude key). No emojis.

morning.text: good morning! have a good day at work ok?
morning. did you eat breakfast or just coffee again

howsYourDay.text: okay tell me everything, how's work today

lunch.text: lunch time. go eat something real please
did you eat? don't skip lunch again

water.text: water break, and stretch a little

goodbye.text: work's done. go home and rest
okay that's enough work for today

tap.text: stop poking me and get back to work

reply.text: add a Claude API key in Settings so I can really talk to you

afterCall.text: how did the call go? did it get settled?

workingLate.text: still here? don't stay too late
working late again? go home soon ok
